components.name: api-client
components.description: Transport core for every frontend API client: URL building, the no-client-tenant guard, error normalisation (Constitution 13 §108, §245). Browser- and mobile-safe.

components.name: api-contracts
components.description: API request/response contracts shared by apps/api and every frontend, split by realm (Constitution 13 §13-15), plus the realm-independent runtime contracts §13 names (pagination bounds, date-range caps). Browser-safe and dependency-free: no imports outside this package.

components.name: auth
components.description: Authentication primitives (Constitution 13 §70): credential hashing (scrypt, self-describing, rehash detection) and the password policy (strength rule, temporary-password generator). Framework-free, no business roles. Sessions, MFA, passkeys and the auth services stay in apps/api until each is extracted with its own measurement.

components.name: cache
components.description: The tenant-scoped read-through cache PORT (Constitution 13 §94) and the ONE Redis client factory (makeIoredis: an instrumented ioredis client, role-labelled for Constitution 11 §44 telemetry). Which store a feature uses, and every connection URL, remain the API's decision. Purpose-specific, not a generic 'utils' package (§115).

components.name: config
components.description: Typed application configuration (Constitution 13 §83–84): values DERIVED from the environment in one place, every function taking the env as a parameter (default process.env) so it is testable and never read ad hoc. Starts with the platform URLs (the tenant portal base every invite link and branded email uses).

components.name: database
components.description: The typed Kysely schema (DB), the DATABASE/DATABASE_READ handles and the global Nest DatabaseModule (Constitution 13 §72). Consumed compiled by the API.

components.name: date-time
components.description: Calendar and time-zone primitives: business date, zoned parts, wall-clock to epoch, YMD arithmetic (Constitution 13 §87). Pure, no date library.

components.name: events
components.description: Domain event infrastructure (Constitution 13 §75): the event envelope and registry (event-contract), the consumer helpers, and the OutboxWriter every domain module writes through inside its own transaction (Constitution 8 §18-19). The publisher pipeline, replay, retention and the Super Admin event operations stay in apps/api. ./nest exports EventsCoreModule, which provides OutboxWriter.

components.name: media
components.description: Media storage (Constitution 13 §115: purpose-specific, not 'utils'): the MediaStorage PORT, the local-disk and S3 adapters, MEDIA_URL_PREFIX, and makeMediaStorage (MEDIA_STORE / MEDIA_S3_* from an env the caller passes). Technician profiles, the nail showcase and support attachments all store files through it.

components.name: mobile-sdk
components.description: Mobile auth, secure storage, biometrics, passkeys and device identity shared by the four Capacitor apps (Constitution 13 §89). Mobile-safe; never imports a server package.

components.name: money
components.description: Integer-cents money type, exact parsing, the distinct display rules, and largest-remainder allocation — the platform's money kernel (Constitution 13 §86). Pure; consumed compiled by the API (dist/) and as source by the frontends.

components.name: notifications
components.description: Provider-neutral delivery adapters (Constitution 13 §78): the SmsSender and EmailSender ports with their Twilio and SendGrid implementations and in-memory mocks, instrumented through @aipowersalon/observability. No message content and no business workflow — those stay with the domain that sends (communications, auth, reminders).

components.name: observability
components.description: The observability kernel (Constitution 13 §80): structured redacted logging, the metrics registry, request/correlation ids and async context, build info, and the telemetry adapters (jobs, providers, database, Redis, realtime, HTTP requests). Health aggregation, SLOs, alerts and the System Operations surface stay in apps/api — they are the platform's operations DOMAIN, not the kernel.

components.name: permissions
components.description: The authorization kernel (roles, capabilities, tenant/branch scope, client-key stripping) and the Nest guards every controller uses (Constitution 13 §76–77). Consumed compiled by the API.

components.name: realtime-contracts
components.description: Client-safe realtime event contracts (Constitution 13 §77): the ONE event registry (names, versions, rooms, event→screen routing) and the envelope shape, shared by apps/api, packages/realtime-client and every app; plus the server-side emitter port (REALTIME token + RealtimeEmitter interface) that domain modules publish through. Dependency-free and browser-safe.

components.name: security
components.description: Encryption primitives (AES-256-GCM, both wire formats at rest) and display masking, shared by the API. Pure: no env, no DB. Built to dist/ — backend packages are consumed compiled (apps/api pins rootDir).

components.name: tenant-context
components.description: Trusted tenant context (Constitution 13 §72–74): the TenantContext / BranchContext / RequestContext shapes, the ONE derivation of a request's context from its verified session (contextFromSession), and the ONE factory for a worker or scheduler acting for a tenant with no user (systemContext). No app implements its own currentTenant logic; nothing here is a global mutable (§74). Foundation: dependency-free, framework-free.

components.name: testing
components.description: Shared test helpers (Constitution 13 §90): the migrated-PGlite real-schema harness (all migrations, cached by content hash). Test-only: never a production dependency (§91, enforced by the architecture gate). Source-only; consumed by vitest.

components.name: web-push
components.description: Browser push (FCM web tokens) for the desktop apps — pos-web, owner-web, admin-web. ONE client, ONE service worker, served by tooling/vite/web-push-sw.mjs.
